caveats.source: Lu-conditioned 7CCN; same peptide as consumed7CCO, a distinct prospective deformation, not a blind protein benchmark.
caveats.geometry: Exact prior whole-MACE La start and 80-step terminal; terminal bound/admitted but nonconverged. No new geometry or optimization.
caveats.terminal_chemistry: Conditional free NH3+/COO- and five deprotonated acidic side chains; experimental terminal specification unresolved.
caveats.vacuum_dianion: Post-added fixed-FF ALPB does not polarize the vacuum density; finite-basis SCF convergence does not prove electron binding or ground-state stability.
caveats.frozen_f: Physical La1/Dy6; effective singlets, La ECP46/Dy ECP55, no SOC or physical-state qualification.
caveats.force: Native analytic admission only, no finite-difference or force-accuracy qualification. Both Dy MACE force comparisons unavailable; no new MACE requests.
caveats.interpretation: Per-metal deformation works and Dy-minus-La work difference; no absolute cross-method energies, affinity, classifier or preference claims.

scheduler_costs: Actual completion/accounting receipts remain authoritative; application timing is not utilization.
